content: विदूषक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Defiling, polluting, contaminating, corrupting. .²2 Detracting, abusing. .²3 Witty, humorous, jocular. .{@-कः@} .²1 A jester, buffoon. .²2 Particularly, the humorous companion and confidential friend of the hero in a play, who excites mirth by his quaint dress, speeches, gestures, appearances <ab>&c.</ab>, and by allowing himself to be made the butt of ridicule by almost every body; the <ls>S. D.</ls> thus defines him:-- कुसुमवसन्ताद्यभिधः कर्मवपुर्वेशभाषाद्यैः . हास्यकरः कलहरतिर्विदूषकः स्यात् स्वकर्मज्ञः .. <ls n="S. D.">79</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also शृङ्गारस्य सहाया विटचेटविदूषकाद्याः स्युः . भक्ता नर्मसु निपुणाः कुपितवधूमानभञ्जनाः शुद्धाः .. {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} .²3 A libertine, lecher. .²4 A critic; an opponent; प्राशंसि संसद्गुरुणापि चार्वी चार्वाकता सर्वविदूषकेण <ls>N. 10. 57</ls>.
